english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something relating to or looking back on the past, especially in titles or descriptions.

examples.english: This retrospective exhibition showcases the director’s work over many years.
examples.traditional: 呢個回顧性展覽展出咗導演多年來嘅作品。
